fusions.name: Beat the Covert
fusions.desc: Beats the ground in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, which deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 35% chance to leave each one [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 8 tiles away and strikes, which deals 14 damage, leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds and makes it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Downwind Approach
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Blood Trail
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
